camel_example: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/experiments --region cn-hangzhou --Order DESC --OrderBy 'GmtCreateTime_DESC,Name_ASC' --Options '{"match_name_exactly":"true"}' --PageSize 10 --Verbose false --PageNumber 1 --SortBy GmtCreateTime --MaxResults 10 --WorkspaceId 151700 --PageToken 0 --Labels 'is_evaluation:true' --Name 'exp-test' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace list-experiment --name exp-test --workspace-id 151700 --labels is_evaluation:true --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order-by GmtCreateTime_DESC,Name_ASC --page-token 0 --max-results 10 --verbose false --options match_name_exactly=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListExperiment

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the workspace where the experiment resides. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html.

If you do not specify a workspace ID, the system returns the list of experiments in the default workspace
parameters.help_zh:
实验所在工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html。
不填写工作空间ID，系统将返回默认工作空间的实验列表
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for labels. Separate multiple conditions with commas (,). A single filter condition must be in the `Key=Value` format
parameters.help_zh:
标签过滤条件，多个条件以半角逗号（,）分隔。
单个条件过滤格式为`Key=Value`
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The field to use for sorting in a paged query. Currently, only the GmtCreateTime field is supported for sorting
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的排序字段。目前GmtCreateTime字段用于排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The order in which to sort the results of a paged query. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order.

DESC (default): descending order
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。
ASC：升序。
DESC（默认）：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A list of sorting methods as strings. You can sort by the following fields: GmtCreateTime, Name, GmtModifiedTime, or ExperimentId. The sorting methods are DESC and ASC. The default is ASC
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式字符串列表，支持排序的字段包括：GmtCreateTime、Name、GmtModifiedTime或ExperimentId。排序方式包括DESC和ASC，默认为ASC
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The paging token. It starts from 0. The default is 0
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. The default is 10
parameters.help_zh: 请求的最大结果数，默认为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retrieve the LatestRun information related to the experiment
parameters.help_zh: 是否获取于实验相关的LatestRun信息
parameters.name: verbose

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to perform an exact match for the name. Valid values are "true" and "false"
fields.help_zh: 是否精确匹配名称，可以填“true“或”false“
fields.name: match_name_exactly
